description: READ-ONLY: fetch the latest crypto headlines as keyword-matched news clusters for fundamentals analysis (ETF flows, unlocks, macro, hacks — read the headlines here, act through a propose_* tool). Optional pair (BTC, ETH, or SOL — also accepts BTC/USDT or BTC-USD forms) narrows to that asset's keywords; omit it for all three. Returns the top clusters newest-first with per-item source links and recency (publishedAt + ageHrs) plus a fetch timestamp; quote them as 'observed at <time> from <source>'. If no headlines match, say so — NEVER invent a headline.

limit.description: Max items kept per asset cluster, 1..12 (default 6).

pair.description: Optional asset filter: BTC, ETH, or SOL (BTC/USDT and BTC-USD forms accepted). Omit for all three.

source.description: Optional feed filter: CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, or Decrypt (case-insensitive). Omit for all three feeds.

name: read_news_brief
title: Read crypto news brief
